# Sultana Food Industry

> Maker of traditional handmade laddoo (laddu), Thank You wedding favours (door gifts for weddings / door gift kahwin), gift boxes, chilled desserts and drinks, and dessert table catering. Based in Selangor, Malaysia, with delivery across Malaysia.

- Website: https://sultanafood.com/
- WhatsApp / phone: +60 16-800 9417 (https://wa.me/60168009417)
- Location: Selangor, Malaysia. Delivers across Malaysia.
- Languages: English, Bahasa Melayu

## Products
- Laddoo Trays: laddoo arranged on trays for kenduri, open houses and family gatherings.
- "Thank You" Wedding Favours: each laddoo sealed in its own floral Thank You pouch, for guests at a walimah or wedding.
- Signature Gift Box: six premium laddoo with cashew, pistachio and silver leaf in a maroon box; for corporate gifts and Hari Raya.
- Lai Chee Kang: chilled dessert of lychee, longan, red dates, white fungus, barley and grass jelly in light syrup.
- Air Limau Jelly: calamansi lime drink with colourful jelly, nata de coco and selasih seeds over ice.

## Wedding & event packages
Laddoo packages of 100, 500 (most popular) and 1000 pieces, each laddoo individually packed in a Thank You pouch.

## Events & catering
Dessert tables with laddoo towers, Lai Chee Kang and chilled drinks for walimah, kenduri, weddings, corporate events, hotels and cafés, Hari Raya and Deepavali.

## Ordering
Send the event date, quantity and delivery area by WhatsApp (016-800 9417). Sultana replies with availability and a quote. Prices are quoted per order.

## Stockists
Sweet shops, mini markets, cafés and resellers can apply for wholesale pricing, steady supply and point-of-sale display support.
